note: Topic classification. A series is placed in a topic only if a rule below matches. `seed_series` are series tickers whose existence and subject matter were found on Kalshi documentation (source listed per row). They are SEEDS, not a census: the app re-discovers live series every refresh via GET /series and GET /events, and anything discovered at runtime is labelled discovered:true. A seed row without a source_id is invalid and scripts/verify-sources.mjs fails the build.

thresholds.alert_move_note: Requested threshold: >= $0.10 in either direction on the contract price. Applied to observed price changes between consecutive observations of one market (print detector) and to the price now versus the price one drift-window ago (drift detector).
thresholds.high_roi_min_edge_note: Minimum EXPECTED edge per contract after official fees before a signal is promoted to the high-ROI chat. $0.005 is deliberately small because a maker capturing half of a 1-2 cent spread only earns about a cent; requiring a larger edge would promote nothing and hide the model's judgement.
thresholds.high_roi_min_return_bps_note: Promotion also requires expected edge / capital >= 1.5% (150 bps) and the price move to be at least 2x the observed spread, so the high-ROI chat stays selective.
